ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].

onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.

Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].

Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and balance indexing.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
msg.sender is used to index the balances mapping in transfer.
msg.sender is used to index the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before changing owner.
transfer writes updated balances for msg.sender and to.
transfer computes balances via safeSub and safeAdd arithmetic.
transferFrom computes balance and allowance updates via safeSub and safeAdd.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an untrusted spender contract after state update.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
Allowance written by approve can be consumed by the callback path in approveAndCall.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary external token contract without a reentrancy guard.
transferOwnership stores the candidate address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership moves newOwner into owner and zeroes newOwner.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable adjusted by balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter a feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition in safeAdd.
safeSub implements the checked subtraction used in the balance arithmetic.
safeAdd implements the checked addition used in the balance arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to is only used by transfer for crediting balances[to].
Parameter tokens is only used by transfer as the transfer amount.
Parameter spender is only used by approve as the allowance key.
Parameter from is only used by transferFrom as the debited account.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used by allowance as the lookup key.
Parameter data is only used by approveAndCall and forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter _newOwner is only used by transferOwnership to set newOwner.
Parameter tokenAddress is only used by transferAnyERC20Token as the external call target.
Parameter a is only used by safeAdd as the left operand.
Parameter b is only used by safeAdd as the right operand.
Local variable c is only the result of the addition inside safeAdd.
